column1: # Verification corpus — one real repo per language for the CI ground-truth matrix.
#   oracle: ast | ripper | goparser | tsnode | ctags
#           (Tier A canonical = gated to 0-diff; Tier B ctags/tsnode-js = report-only/coarse)
#   ref:    empty = default branch; pin to the captured SHA after a clean run.
# ctags supports 38 of our 56. The 38 below have confident corpus repos and run
# all at once on GitHub's parallel runners. NOT ctags-supported

# mojo nim nix prolog scala smalltalk solidity swift visualbasic wasm zig.
